newsitem.title: USA: Newspaper reports on writing of JonBenet's mother.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper reports on writing of JonBenet's mother.

text.p: The Rocky Mountain News reported on Tuesday that a handwriting sample from the mother of slain child beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey allegedly came from the same notebook as one used to write the ransom note.

The newspaper said a sample of Patsy Ramsey's handwriting that was given to police by her husband on the day of the murder was later determined to have come from the same legal pad used for the ransom note.

Six-year-old JonBenet's body was found on Dec. 26 by her father, John Ramsey, in the basement of their posh Boulder home, several hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
Boulder spokeswoman Leslie Aaholm had no comment on the newspaper article.

The newspaper, quoting unidentified sources, said John Ramsey turned over the pad after police asked for samples of his and Patsy Ramsey's handwriting. "He told investigators he could get them samples of Patsy's handwriting -- with no indication he knew what else the notebook had been used for, the sources said," according to the newspaper.

"It was after he (John) retrieved the notebook and gave it to police that a detective leafed through it and discovered a sheet with the heading 'Mr and Mrs. Ramsey' - but no other writing," the Rocky Mountain News said.
The "Mr. and Mrs. Ramsey" jotted down in the legal pad was later found to have been a practice note for the actual ransom letter, the newspaper said.

In a separate development in the case, Aaholm said investigators were working on Tuesday in the Ramsey's home to take measurements for an architectural model of the house which will be used for a case presentation to the district attorney's office and ultimately for a court case.

No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the six-month old investigation into who killed the little girl. "There continue to be materials still being tested," Aaholm said. The Ramseys consented to the police entry into the home.
A plumber was seen entering the home, carrying a tool box and a pipe wrench. Aaholm said she had no information about the plumber.
The Ramseys, who are on vacation in northern Michigan, left their Boulder home shortly after the murder. Patsy Ramsey has said she will never live in the house again.
